purpose: Reference scaffolding for cat-25 personal/hobbyist UCs ingesting vendor APIs via HEC (Splunkbase 617). Authors adapt — do not paste verbatim into sidecars.

ta.name: Splunk HTTP Event Collector
ta.scope: HEC token on indexer or heavy forwarder; index=personal with 90–365d retention.

kfps.scenario: OAuth refresh token expired — connector stops polling but old events remain in index.
kfps.distinguish: index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd group=http_event_collector shows 401; vendor API returns auth errors in connector log.
kfps.suppress: Do not suppress — fix token in passwords.conf / env; optionally filter stale `_time` rows after re-auth.

kfps.scenario: Rest day or injury — zero activities is expected, not a ingestion failure.
kfps.distinguish: Vendor app shows no workouts; index=personal has no rows for that calendar day.
kfps.suppress: Personal choice — adjust alert to weekly goal only, not daily zero-activity.

kfps.scenario: Multi-device double-count — same workout synced from watch and phone.
kfps.distinguish: Duplicate external_id or overlapping start_time from two sourcetypes.
kfps.suppress: Dedup in SPL with `stats latest(*) by external_id` or filter one sourcetype via lookup.

kfps.scenario: Timezone bucket misalignment — weekly bins on UTC vs local training schedule.
kfps.distinguish: Compare vendor weekly total to SPL `bin _time span=1w` with and without offset.
kfps.suppress: Document local offset in detailedImplementation; do not use enterprise exception registers.

troubleshooting.cause: HEC token revoked or connector cron disabled
troubleshooting.fix: Renew token; check `systemctl status` / cron; search `_internal` HEC rejections

troubleshooting.symptom: NULL fields after vendor API change
troubleshooting.cause: JSON shape drift in webhook payload
troubleshooting.fix: Compare raw event with `head 1 | spath`; update connector field map before SPL
